ICS 87.040; 87.100
ICS 87.040; 87.100
CHD 23
CHD 23
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 1) prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for flat brushes for paints and varnishes, made from bristles and set in suitable cement.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contains provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
